verdict.rationale: Nitrokey ships versioned artifacts: the nitropy CLI 0.13.0, the Python SDK 0.4.2 and tagged firmware releases (v1.8.3). Nothing in the evidence describes a versioned API contract or any documented deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Package version numbers alone are adjacent to this story and do not deliver it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
